items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: So, Dick Taylor started to drive.

ctx.x: You were talking about your band being... Oh, the swing area?

About the swing area. Right. That reminds me of one time when we were going through Florida and the bus had broken down in Mobile, Alabama. I stayed up all night to get it fixed. And consequently, I was tired. So, Dick Taylor started to drive. We were going down to... I think it was mine. We were going through Tallahassee. We had to stop in Tallahassee and get a permit to travel a state. We'd pay a penny a mile to travel a state of Florida. So, when we crossed the bridge, we had a place in the back where the…
Well, you guys' song were pretty dark in the band.
